title: Ensure device storage encryption is active
description: Android 10+ devices ship with file-based encryption enabled by default; older or modified devices can be unencrypted. ro.crypto.state reports encrypted when FBE/FDE is active. The audit uses adb against the single attached device (set ANDROID_SERIAL when several are connected) and FAILS when adb is missing or no authorised device is connected. adb requires USB debugging, so disable Developer options again after the audit.
reference: CIS Google Android Benchmark - Encryption (verify section number for your release)

audit.command:
out=$(adb shell getprop ro.crypto.state 2>/dev/null) || exit 1
state=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tr -d '\r[:space:]')
if [ "$state" = encrypted ]; then echo compliant; else echo "ro.crypto.state=${state:-unset}"; fi

remediation.command: Devices shipping Android 10+ are encrypted by default; if ro.crypto.state is not 'encrypted' (custom ROM, unlocked bootloader or legacy device) back up, relock the bootloader / reflash stock firmware or retire the device. Legacy devices: Settings > Security > Encrypt phone. EMM: Android Management API policy encryptionPolicy=ENABLED_WITH_PASSWORD.

reference: CIS Google Android Benchmark v1.6.0 - 3.1 Ensure 'Microphone' is set to 'Enabled'

audit.command: Follow the below steps to verify that Microphone is Enabled: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Site settings > Verify that Microphone displays Ask first.

remediation.command: Follow the below steps to Enable the Microphone permission request: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Site settings > Microphone > Toggle to the ON position.

title: Ensure 'Location' is set to 'Enabled'
description: This setting controls if a site asks before accessing the location. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled.
reference: CIS Google Android Benchmark v1.6.0 - 3.2 Ensure 'Location' is set to 'Enabled'

audit.command: Follow the below steps to verify that Location is Enabled: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Site settings > Verify that Location displays Ask first.

remediation.command: Follow the below steps to Enable the Location permission request: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Site settings > Location > Toggle to the ON position.

title: Ensure 'Allow third-party cookies' is set to 'Disabled'
description: A third-party cookie is sent by a domain that differs from the domain in the browser's address bar. The recommended state for this setting is: Disabled.
reference: CIS Google Android Benchmark v1.6.0 - 3.3 Ensure 'Allow third-party cookies' is set to 'Disabled'

audit.command: Follow the below steps to verify that Allow third-party cookies is Disabled: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Site settings > Verify that Allow third-party cookies displays Allowed, except third- party.

remediation.command: Follow the below steps to Disabled the Allow third-party cookies option: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Site settings > Allow third-party cookies > Uncheck the Allow third-party cookies checkbox.

title: Ensure 'Search and URL suggestions' is set to 'Disabled'
description: Google Chrome uses a prediction service to show related searches, matches from browsing history, and popular websites while a user types in the address bar. The recommended state for this setting is: Disabled.
reference: CIS Google Android Benchmark v1.6.0 - 3.5 Ensure 'Search and URL suggestions' is set to 'Disabled'

audit.command: Follow the below steps to verify that Search and URL suggestions is Disabled: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Privacy > Verify that Search and URL suggestions checkbox is unchecked.

remediation.command: Follow the below steps to Disable the Search and URL suggestions feature: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Privacy > Uncheck the Search and URL suggestions checkbox.

title: Ensure 'Do Not Track' is set to 'Enabled'
description: When browsing the web on computers or Android devices, users can request websites not to collect or track browsing data. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled. Note: Chrome doesn't provide details of which websites and web services respect Do Not Track requests and how websites interpret them.
reference: CIS Google Android Benchmark v1.6.0 - 3.6 Ensure 'Do Not Track' is set to 'Enabled'

audit.command: Follow the below steps to verify that Do Not Track is Enabled: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Privacy > Do Not Track > Verify that Do Not Track toggle is on.

remediation.command: Follow the below steps to Enabled the Do Not Track feature: Chrome Icon > Menu Icon > Settings > Privacy > Do Not Track > Toggle the Do Not Track to the ON position.
